projects.title: Welcome To JULY
projects.challenge: Monthly welcome posts are among the most overlooked content opportunities for personal brands. This design needed to do more than mark a new month — it had to reinforce David's brand authority, express genuine warmth toward his audience, and stop the scroll in a visually saturated social feed.
projects.solution: A bold 1:1 social media graphic with a dramatic deep crimson and warm gold radial gradient background. The hero element is a large 3D metallic gold "JULY" typographic lockup with realistic depth, glow, and cinematic lighting. A professional photo of David Omigie is composited into the left side of the frame with a warm oval spotlight cutout effect. "WELCOME TO" is set in refined white serif uppercase with gold accent rules, paired with the motivational message "Let's achieve greater things together this month." The OMG logo badge anchors the top-right corner, with social handles and website URL displayed in the gold footer bar — delivering a premium brand touchpoint that feels editorial and memorable.

projects.title: Welcome to August
projects.challenge: A simple "Welcome to August" post wasn't enough. This flyer needed to celebrate the new month while reinforcing OMG Tech Hub's professional identity and communicating appreciation to existing clients. The challenge was to combine a warm goodwill message with strong brand visibility in a single social media graphic that would capture attention, feel premium, and encourage businesses to trust OMG Tech Hub with their digital growth this month.
projects.solution: A premium square social media flyer built around a rich burgundy and crimson gradient with soft bokeh lighting to create depth and visual warmth. The oversized cream-and-gold "AUGUST" typography serves as the primary focal point, supported by an elegant serif "Welcome to" heading for a refined editorial feel. A professionally composited portrait of David Omigie occupies the right side, balancing the layout while establishing a strong personal brand presence. Floating business-themed visual elements, including currency and smartphone graphics, subtly reinforce business growth and digital innovation. The appreciation message is positioned for clear readability, while the OMG Tech Hub logo and contact information anchor the composition, resulting in a polished promotional design that strengthens brand recognition and encourages continued client engagement.

projects.title: Welcome to April
projects.challenge: This promotional flyer needed to welcome a new month while positioning OMG Tech Hub as the go-to creative and web development partner for businesses. The challenge was to balance a bold, futuristic visual style with a clear marketing message, ensuring the design immediately captured attention, communicated professionalism, and inspired potential clients to invest in high-quality digital solutions.
projects.solution: A high-impact square social media flyer featuring a futuristic blue and violet gradient environment enhanced with dynamic light streaks, glowing particles, and abstract geometric elements to create depth and motion. The oversized metallic white "APRIL" typographic lockup dominates the composition, reinforced by a subtle reflective floor effect that adds a premium, modern aesthetic. A clean gold "Welcome to" heading introduces the message, while strategically highlighted red typography emphasizes key value propositions such as "Add Value" and "Stand Out" to guide the viewer's attention. The OMG Tech Hub logo is prominently positioned at the top for instant brand recognition, while a minimalist WhatsApp contact card anchors the footer, creating a polished promotional asset that combines visual impact with effective business communication.

projects.title: Xperience Perfumes Brand Flyer
projects.challenge: Xperience Perfumes needed a product-focused promotional design that could communicate confidence, elegance, and youthful sophistication while making the perfume and body spray visually irresistible. The challenge was to create a composition that would go beyond simply displaying the products — it needed to establish a memorable brand identity, connect fragrance with personality, and capture attention in a competitive social media environment.
projects.solution: A bold editorial-style product advertisement built around a muted mauve background and a striking oversized "X" visual motif that serves as the central design element. A carefully composed fashion portrait is integrated into the letterform, creating a seamless connection between the model, the brand identity, and the products. The Xperience body spray and perfume bottle are positioned prominently at the bottom as the primary product focus, supported by strong messaging such as "Smell Nice, Feel Bold" and "Classic Body Spray." Repeated Xperience typography, floral illustrations, floating heart motifs, and strategic hand elements add personality and visual depth, while the black, red, gold, and cream product palette reinforces a premium fragrance aesthetic.

projects.title: Happy Birthday
projects.challenge: The birthday flyer needed to celebrate Kingsley in a way that felt personal, vibrant, and visually memorable rather than looking like a generic birthday template. The design had to place the celebrant at the center of attention while incorporating a warm celebratory atmosphere, clear birthday messaging, and a polished visual identity suitable for sharing across social media.
projects.solution: A vibrant birthday portrait composition built around a soft light-blue background with layered photographic frames that create depth and draw attention toward the celebrant. The central portrait is given the strongest visual emphasis, while the surrounding blue textures, sparkling stars, floral illustrations, and subtle decorative elements establish a joyful celebratory mood. The prominent "Happy Birthday" script typography creates an expressive focal point, complemented by Kingsley's name and the 03/09 date badge. A refined "Wishing You Long Life and Prosperity" message anchors the bottom of the design, while the subtle OMG Graphics branding maintains authorship without competing with the celebrant.

projects.title: Bikers' Gang Promotional Flyer
projects.challenge: Bikers' Gang needed a promotional design that could capture the freedom, adventure, power, and rebellious spirit of motorcycle culture while presenting the group with a distinctive visual identity. The challenge was to create an energetic composition that would immediately appeal to motorcycle enthusiasts and communicate the thrill of riding, exploration, and breaking away from the ordinary.
projects.solution: A bold editorial-style motorcycle flyer built around a deep burgundy background with subtle particles, stars, and atmospheric textures that establish a dramatic, adventurous mood. The headline "BIKERS GANG" uses distressed typography to introduce a rugged visual character, while the central composition combines a female rider and high-performance motorcycle imagery with geometric cream-colored shapes for a striking modern layout. The "Cruise all Future Lanes Away" message creates the core travel narrative, supported by "Join the ride to freedom" and the powerful closing statement "BREAK THE BONDAGE". Carefully structured typography, contrasting cream and white tones, and the motorcycle imagery work together to create a design that feels adventurous, unconventional, and visually commanding.

projects.title: Burger King Brand Identity
projects.challenge: Burger King needed a promotional design that could make its food offering look irresistible, indulgent, and instantly recognizable while maintaining a strong visual connection to the brand. The challenge was to transform a standard food advertisement into a high-impact composition that would stimulate appetite, communicate the product's quality, and capture attention in a crowded social media environment.
projects.solution: A bold food-focused promotional flyer built around a warm cream and caramel color palette that immediately creates an appetizing atmosphere. The centerpiece is a highly detailed, oversized double-stacked burger surrounded by dramatic cheese and sauce splashes, creating a sense of freshness, indulgence, and movement. The burger is integrated into large typography, allowing the product imagery to become part of the headline itself and creating a strong visual hierarchy. A handwritten "Refresh your soul, you've earned it!" tagline adds personality and emotional appeal, while floating food particles and ingredients reinforce the culinary theme. The clean footer consolidates the social media handle and website, resulting in a polished promotional asset designed to generate appetite and encourage customer interaction.

projects.title: Burger King Banner Mockup
projects.challenge:
A strong promotional design can lose some of its perceived impact when viewed only as a flat digital graphic. The challenge was to demonstrate how the Burger King artwork would look in a real-world advertising environment while preserving the original composition, typography, product imagery, and branding.
The flyer needed to be integrated naturally into a large vertical advertising display without distorting its proportions or compromising its visual details. The perspective, lighting, reflections, surrounding architecture, and nighttime environment also needed to complement the advertisement rather than distract from it.
projects.solution:
The original Burger King flyer was placed within a premium backlit outdoor advertising frame and positioned against a modern commercial building. The angled perspective creates a realistic sense of depth, while the surrounding architectural surfaces and nighttime city environment establish an authentic advertising context. The illuminated display naturally draws attention to the warm food photography and bold typography, demonstrating how the design could command visibility in a real-world setting.
The mockup transformed the Burger King flyer from a standalone digital design into a believable outdoor advertising campaign. It demonstrates the design's scalability and visual strength in a physical environment while giving the client a clearer representation of how the finished artwork could appear to consumers in a high-traffic location.

projects.title: 2K+ LinkedIn Family Flyer
projects.challenge:
Milestones such as reaching 2,000+ connections can easily be communicated with a simple number and generic thank-you message. The challenge was to turn the achievement into a visually compelling story that made the audience feel like part of the journey rather than simply announcing a milestone.
The design needed to communicate several ideas simultaneously: the 2K+ milestone, gratitude to the LinkedIn community, personal growth, and the creator's identity. A large background portrait, foreground portrait, oversized typography, LinkedIn-inspired elements, and supporting text all needed to work together without competing for attention.
projects.solution:
A rich textured blue background was used to establish a strong connection with LinkedIn's visual identity while creating enough contrast for the white typography and portrait imagery. The oversized "2K+" became the primary focal point, immediately communicating the achievement, while "LINKEDIN Family" transformed the milestone into a personal message of appreciation. A large, softly treated portrait was positioned in the background to create depth, while a sharper foreground portrait establishes a stronger personal connection with the audience. Subtle LinkedIn icons and translucent graphic elements were layered throughout the composition to reinforce the platform without overwhelming the main message. The concise "Thanks for all we've achieved together" statement completes the emotional narrative by positioning the milestone as a shared achievement.
The final design transformed a simple connection milestone into a personal appreciation campaign. It communicates growth, gratitude, and community in a visually powerful way while keeping the creator at the center of the story. The result is a celebratory graphic that not only marks the 2K+ milestone but also strengthens the sense of connection between the creator and his LinkedIn family.
